services.name: Private Sprinter Mansion Tour
services.desc: Enjoy Newport on Your Schedule. Duration Minimum of 3 Hours About Our 14 Passenger Mercedes Sprinter and local guide will show you around Newport on your schedule. This tour can be tailored to adding mansions and or additional stops for lunch or shopping. The base tour pricing includes admission into one of the famed Newport Mansions (Breakers, Marble House, Rosecliff or Elms (subject to availability)) as well as our standard 90 Minute Scenic Tour of Newport. If your group has a different itinerary in mind we can tailor this tour to meet your needs! The included pricing is based on a minimum of 6 Passengers. Mansion admissions can be added on at additional per person
